name: Shephatiah (son of Jehoshaphat)
title: Jewish king's son killed by his brother
summary: Shephatiah was one of King Jehoshaphat's sons who was killed by his brother Joram along with the other brothers when Joram secured his throne.

keyEvents.title: Killed by his brother Joram
keyEvents.description: Shephatiah was among Jehoshaphat's sons whom Joram killed when he took over the kingship.
